documentation_excerpts.text: Semble is a code search library built for agents. It returns the exact code snippets they need instantly, using ~99% fewer tokens than grep+read. Indexing and searching a full codebase end-to-end takes under a second for most repos, matching the retrieval quality of a code-specialized transformer while indexing ~380x faster and querying ~17x faster (see [benchmarks](#benchmarks)). Everything runs on CPU with no API keys, GPU, or external services. Use it as an MCP server, a CLI tool via AGENTS.m
Your agent queries Semble in natural language (e.g. `"How is authentication handled?"`) and gets back only the relevant code snippets, without grepping or reading full files.
